{{Top|leg}}
'''Elomic physical calculus''' is a [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] instrument to analyze the logic of different scenarios. It consists of a balance table and a compartmented canister of [[Color/Legends|colored]] hemispherical weights. The Elomin [[Notoganarech]] predicted the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|victory]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] using this instrument.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
